name: photoprism
readme_excerpt: PhotoPrism: Browse Your Life in Pictures PhotoPrism® is an AI-powered, privacy-first app for browsing, organizing, and sharing photos and videos. It helps tag, search, and rediscover media without getting in your way, whether self-hosted or in the cloud. To get a first impression, you are welcome to play with our public demo.
